name: fmp_stock_quote
description:
Latest quote for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/quote): price, change and change %, volume, day high/low, 52-week range, market cap, PE and similar fields.
Returns {symbol, quote}: quote is FMP's first quote record.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased).
For daily price history use fmp_historical_price; for other assets fmp_index_quote, fmp_forex_quote, fmp_crypto_quote or fmp_commodity_quote.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)

quote.description: Real-time quote with price, change, volume, marketCap
